body.name: Ten-variable terminal-splitting systems
body.construction: For fixed \(k_0\in\mathcal A\), \(s\in\{-1,1\}^{3}\), and \(\sigma\in\Sigma\), first impose \(\chi_{0k_0}^{01}=\chi_{0k_0}^{10}=\chi_{0k_0}^{11}=0\) and set \(v_{10k_0}=v_{20k_0}=N_0(0,0,k_0)/H_0(0,0,k_0)\). Retain \(r_{ij}=R_{10}(i,j,k_0)\), set \(R_{20}(i,j,k_0)=H_0(i,j,k_0)-r_{ij}\), and for each of the other three blocks set \(R_{1d}(i,j,k)=[N_d(i,j,k)-v_{2dk}H_d(i,j,k)]/(v_{1dk}-v_{2dk})\) and \(R_{2d}=H_d-R_{1d}\). The free coordinate is exactly \(y=(v_{110},v_{210},v_{111},v_{211},v_{10,1-k_0},v_{20,1-k_0},r_{00},r_{01},r_{10},r_{11})\in\mathbb R^{10}\). The system \(\mathscr G_{k_0,s,\sigma}(P,\eta;y)\) contains the eight cleared equalities \(\rho_{zdj}(R)=0\), the four cleared equalities \(\gamma_{zi}^{\sigma}(R)=0\), the three strict orientation signs \(s_{dk}(v_{1dk}-v_{2dk})>0\), \(R_{zd}(i,j,k)\ge\eta^5\), and both cleared signs \(q-\eta\ge0\) and \(U-q\ge0\) for every reconstructed \(q\in\{v_{zdk},u_{zd},a_{zi},\kappa_{zd3j},\pi_z,e_z\}\). Reconstruction uses \(T_{zd}^{R}(i,j)=\sum_kR_{zd}(i,j,k)\), \(S_{zd}^{R}(i)=\sum_jT_{zd}^{R}(i,j)\), \(w_{zd}=\sum_iS_{zd}^{R}(i)\), \(u_{zd}=S_{zd}^{R}(1)/w_{zd}\), \(a_{zi}=T_{z1}^{R}(i,1)/S_{z1}^{R}(i)\), \(\kappa_{zd3j}=R_{zd}(0,j,1)/T_{zd}^{R}(0,j)\), \(\pi_z=p_0w_{\sigma(z),0}+p_1w_{z1}\), and \(e_z=p_1w_{z1}/\pi_z\). Every cleared denominator is one of the explicitly positive quantities \(H_d,T_{zd}^{R},S_{zd}^{R},w_{zd},p_d\) or an orientation-signed terminal difference.
